"""Fixture: refusal reason displayed-output assertion (legacy-kept)."""

from tests.record_builder import RecordBuilder


def test_displayed_output_assertion(capsys) -> None:
    rendered = RecordBuilder().spec(
        title="Displayed Output",
        id6="do1001",
        status="approved",
        text_only=True,
    )
    print(rendered)
    stdout = capsys.readouterr().out
    assert "- Status: approved" in stdout
